Riley met James, Laura, and Kevin for 40 minutes. The group agreed on evaluation criteria (uptime, install timeline, maintenance coverage) and who signs. Laura asked for pricing ranges. A solution demo was set for Oct 2.

Discovery workshop, Sep 17 (meeting): Riley ran a 90 minute workshop with James, Laura, Kevin, and the facilities team at the security operations center and the secondary facility. Asher reviewed adoption data with Angela, Nina, and two admins. Weekly active use is steady, and content usage grew over the last two quarters. The group listed what the new team needs: the existing Solana deployment connector coverage and seat provisioning by January.

Intro call, Sep 1 (call): Ethan spoke with Michael for 25 minutes about Hudson Yards Analytics's 80 enterprise reps. Michael described pipeline reports that managers rebuild by hand every Friday, and new reps take about 95 days to ramp. Michael agreed to a deeper conversation with finance and named Sarah as the budget owner. Next step is the qualification recap, with a meeting on Sep 7.

Qualification recap email, Sep 7 (email): Ethan sent Michael a recap of the intro call covering the stated pain (pipeline reports that managers rebuild by hand every Friday), the 95 days ramp time, and a proposed goal of 65 days. Michael replied the same day confirming accuracy and copying Sarah. A meeting with the economic buyer was requested for Sep 11.

Qualification meeting with economic buyer, Sep 11 (meeting): Ethan met Michael and Sarah for 45 minutes. Sarah confirmed a budget range for 80 seats on a one year term and asked for a business case tied to ramp time. Michael will gather current onboarding numbers. Both agreed to a discovery workshop on Sep 16.

Discovery workshop, Oct 3 (meeting): Asher ran a 90 minute workshop with Daniel, Carla, Steven, and four managers. Findings: 18 planned hires over the next two quarters with no repeatable ramp; ramp time is about 100 days; managers spend roughly four hours a week assembling reports. The group ranked onboarding speed first and CRM data quality second. A current-state deep dive was planned for Oct 9.

Current-state deep dive call, Oct 9 (call): Asher spent 60 minutes with Daniel and two ops leads walking through the systems used by the new AI solutions team of 25 reps.
